messages.subject: Crazy number of notifications from GitHub
parts:
Sorry -- I'm migrating a lot of issues. I didn't realize everyone was getting spammed until Bob and Rob told me. I'm about a third through, so I'm about to spew a whole bunch more.

If you're interested in turning off notifications, go to:

https://github.com/settings/notifications

and turn off notifications. I'm not sure if that will actually stop the flurry, but that's the best suggestion I have now.

Alternatively, you can wait until the activity is over and delete all the messages with a filter. I'll send an email out when I'm done with the migration.


Daniel
